coverage_limit: Curated 14-work frontier map, not an exhaustive claim about all current AI learning theory. Each listed arXiv URL pins the latest version inspected on 2026-09-07; its year/date are the primary record's first-submission year/date, while publication information is separately noted where relevant. Reported efficacy remains task-, model-, budget-, and evaluation-specific. None establishes HSWM efficacy, cognition, continuous learning, or fractal causal closure.

entries.title: ExpeL: LLM Agents Are Experiential Learners
entries.authors: Andrew Zhao, Daniel Huang, Quentin Xu, et al.
entries.inspected_scope: arXiv metadata, abstract, and submission-history version
entries.mechanism: Collects task experiences, extracts natural-language knowledge, and recalls insights and past experiences at inference without parameter updates. The authors report accumulating-experience improvements and qualitative transfer observations.
entries.hswm_bridge: SECONDARY_AI candidate: turn extracted lessons into provenance-bound relation/condition proposals rather than prompt text, then test whether admitted relations change a fresh traversal and outcome.
entries.limitation: Its reported memory is text-mediated; the paper does not supply canonical ownership, causal credit, or intervention evidence for a persistent world model.
entries.falsifier: With matched context and rollout budget, relation-conditioned HSWM cannot exceed a fixed lesson-retrieval control on held-out task variants, or remove/restore of a learned relation has no behavioral effect.
entries.verification_note: Primary arXiv record searched and abstract inspected 2026-09-07; no HSWM claim is inferred.

entries.title: Reflexion: Language Agents with Verbal Reinforcement Learning
entries.authors: Noah Shinn, Federico Cassano, Edward Berman, et al.
entries.inspected_scope: arXiv metadata, abstract, and submission-history version
entries.mechanism: Uses external or simulated feedback to generate verbal reflections held in an episodic memory buffer, aiming to improve later decisions without updating model weights. The authors report gains in sequential decisions, coding, and reasoning tasks.
entries.hswm_bridge: SECONDARY_AI candidate: model reflection as a fallible proposal atom linked to the sealed trajectory and outcome, not as self-validating learning; separately admit only relations surviving counterfactual checks.
entries.limitation: Free-form reflection can confabulate mechanisms and the reported agent-level improvements do not identify which memory content causally produced them.
entries.falsifier: Trajectory-linked reflection proposals fail a blinded held-out outcome test or perform no better than equally sized non-causal summaries after matched retrieval.
entries.verification_note: Primary arXiv record searched and abstract inspected 2026-09-07; reported results are not generalized beyond stated tasks.

entries.title: MemGPT: Towards LLMs as Operating Systems
entries.authors: Charles Packer, Sarah Wooders, Kevin Lin, et al.
entries.inspected_scope: arXiv metadata, abstract, and submission-history version
entries.mechanism: Introduces virtual-context management: an LLM moves information among memory tiers and uses interrupts to manage control flow, extending effective context beyond its native window for documents and multi-session chat.
entries.hswm_bridge: SECONDARY_AI candidate: treat tiered retrieval as a bounded projection/working configuration whose reads are recorded; it can improve access but cannot substitute for canonical learning admission.
entries.limitation: Memory movement and conversational persistence do not establish that stored items are true, causally useful, owner-valid, or learned relations.
entries.falsifier: A provenance-aware retrieval policy yields no gain over a size-matched generic tiered-memory control, or its recorded reads do not predict the next action under replay.
entries.verification_note: Primary arXiv record searched and abstract inspected 2026-09-07.

entries.title: DeepSeek-R1: Incentivizing Reasoning Capability in LLMs via Reinforcement Learning
entries.authors: DeepSeek-AI, Daya Guo, Dejian Yang, et al.
entries.inspected_scope: arXiv metadata, abstract, and submission-history version
entries.mechanism: Reports reasoning models trained with large-scale RL; R1-Zero starts without SFT and R1 adds cold-start data and multi-stage training. The authors report reasoning-task performance and release models.
entries.hswm_bridge: SECONDARY_AI candidate: use outcome-verifiable reasoning tasks to study credit assignment and compute budgets, while distinguishing model-weight training from HSWM's owner-valid macro relation learning.
entries.limitation: Benchmark reasoning performance and chain length do not demonstrate persistent, interpretable causal world-model revision or safe autonomous relation admission.
entries.falsifier: Outcome-bound HSWM relation learning fails to improve on tasks with externally checkable rewards after matching base model, tokens, rollouts, and training/inference budget.
entries.verification_note: Primary arXiv record searched and abstract inspected 2026-09-07; efficacy is the authors' reported benchmark result.

entries.title: s1: Simple test-time scaling
entries.authors: Niklas Muennighoff, Zitong Yang, Weijia Shi, et al.
entries.inspected_scope: arXiv metadata, abstract, and submission-history version
entries.mechanism: Curates 1,000 reasoning traces for supervised finetuning and introduces budget forcing, either truncating reasoning or extending it with a token cue. It reports math-benchmark gains from extra inference compute.
entries.hswm_bridge: SECONDARY_AI candidate: make reasoning-token and action budgets explicit resources in the transition contract, then compare relation learning against a budget-forced no-learning control.
entries.limitation: Longer reasoning can improve a benchmark without changing persistent knowledge, action policy, or causal mechanism; token cost is a major confound.
entries.falsifier: Any apparent conditional-relation gain disappears when the no-learning control receives the same test-time token budget and samples.
entries.verification_note: Primary arXiv record searched and abstract inspected 2026-09-07.

entries.title: Search-R1: Training LLMs to Reason and Leverage Search Engines with Reinforcement Learning
entries.authors: Bowen Jin, Hansi Zeng, Zhenrui Yue, et al.
entries.inspected_scope: arXiv metadata, abstract, and submission-history version
entries.mechanism: Extends a reasoning model so RL trains multi-turn search-query generation during reasoning with real-time retrieval, using retrieved-token masking and outcome-based rewards. The authors report QA gains over named baselines.
entries.hswm_bridge: SECONDARY_AI candidate: represent a tool read/query and its provenance as trajectory atoms, then test whether learned relations improve query selection without allowing retrieval output to become canonical by default.
entries.limitation: Search success can depend on index changes, query leakage, and reward design; it does not establish that tool use creates a validated world model.
entries.falsifier: A learned relation fails to change logged information requests and hold-out tool-task outcomes relative to matched retrieval and query-budget controls.
entries.verification_note: Primary arXiv record searched and abstract inspected 2026-09-07.

entries.title: Mastering Diverse Domains through World Models
entries.authors: Danijar Hafner, Jurgis Pasukonis, Jimmy Ba, Timothy Lillicrap
entries.inspected_scope: arXiv metadata, abstract, and submission-history version
entries.mechanism: DreamerV3 learns an environment model and improves behavior by imagining future scenarios. The authors report a single configuration across more than 150 tasks and Minecraft diamond collection from pixels.
entries.hswm_bridge: SECONDARY_AI candidate: use imagined counterfactual rollouts only as revision proposals; a relation becomes HSWM learning only after external outcome, provenance, and causal-credit tests support admission.
entries.limitation: Latent imagined trajectories can exploit model error; success in a simulator does not prove a canonical, semantic, or open-world world model.
entries.falsifier: Relations promoted from imagined rollouts do not improve real held-out outcomes over model-free or non-promoted-imagination controls, especially after environment shift.
entries.verification_note: Primary arXiv record searched and abstract inspected 2026-09-07.

entries.title: V-JEPA 2: Self-Supervised Video Models Enable Understanding, Prediction and Planning
entries.authors: Mido Assran, Adrien Bardes, David Fan, et al.
entries.inspected_scope: arXiv metadata, abstract, and submission-history version
entries.mechanism: Pretrains a joint-embedding predictive video model on internet video, then post-trains an action-conditioned latent world model from robot video for image-goal planning. The authors report video and robot results.
entries.hswm_bridge: SECONDARY_AI candidate: use a perceptual predictive model as an observation/proposal adapter with explicit mapping loss, keeping semantic atom identity and action credit outside the learned latent space.
entries.limitation: Latent video prediction and robot demonstrations do not provide typed semantics, lineage, permission, or proof that a prediction changed an outcome through HSWM learning.
entries.falsifier: Adding the perceptual adapter fails to improve predeclared embodied outcome metrics over frozen-feature controls, or the adapter's proposed state cannot be audited back to source observations.
entries.verification_note: Primary arXiv record searched and abstract inspected 2026-09-07.

entries.title: V-JEPA 2.1: Unlocking Dense Features in Video Self-Supervised Learning
entries.authors: Lorenzo Mur-Labadia, Matthew Muckley, Amir Bar, et al.
entries.inspected_scope: arXiv metadata, abstract, and submission-history version
entries.mechanism: Uses dense predictive loss, deep self-supervision across encoder layers, multimodal tokenizers, and scale to learn structured image/video features. The authors report anticipation, grasping, navigation, and recognition results.
entries.hswm_bridge: SECONDARY_AI candidate: evaluate dense temporally grounded features as a replaceable observational interface for relation proposals, with source-to-atom provenance and uncertainty retained at the boundary.
entries.limitation: Dense feature quality is not equivalent to causal representation, action-policy learning, or a semantic hypergraph; reported domains do not test HSWM contracts.
entries.falsifier: Feature-derived relation candidates fail source-grounded audit or do not improve held-out action outcomes against equivalent frozen vision baselines.
entries.verification_note: 2026 item: primary arXiv record searched and abstract inspected 2026-09-07.

entries.title: GEPA: Reflective Prompt Evolution Can Outperform Reinforcement Learning
entries.authors: Lakshya A. Agrawal, Shangyin Tan, Dilara Soylu, et al.
entries.inspected_scope: arXiv metadata, abstract, and submission-history version
entries.mechanism: Optimizes textual parameters of compound AI systems by reflecting on rollout traces, proposing prompt updates, and selecting/combining candidates with a Pareto frontier. The authors report task-specific gains over named RL and prompt-optimization comparators.
entries.hswm_bridge: SECONDARY_AI candidate: adapt Pareto selection for pre-admission relation/transition proposals across outcome, cost, and safety metrics, while preserving immutable lineage and independent validation.
entries.limitation: Prompt evolution is an outer optimization loop; it neither establishes semantic relation truth nor provides owner-valid, online canonical revision.
entries.falsifier: Pareto-selected relation proposals do not outperform single-objective and random-mutation controls on preregistered held-out outcomes under the same rollout budget.
entries.verification_note: Primary arXiv record searched and abstract inspected 2026-09-07; ICLR 2026 status was not used as authority.

entries.title: Agentic Context Engineering: Evolving Contexts for Self-Improving Language Models
entries.authors: Qizheng Zhang, Changran Hu, Shubhangi Upasani, et al.
entries.inspected_scope: arXiv metadata, abstract, and submission-history version
entries.mechanism: Treats contexts as evolving playbooks updated through generation, reflection, and curation to preserve detailed knowledge and reduce collapse. The authors report agent and domain-specific benchmark improvements from execution feedback.
entries.hswm_bridge: SECONDARY_AI candidate: use modular context entries as editable projections of proposed relations, with each edit linked to a trajectory/outcome and never mistaken for the canonical state itself.
entries.limitation: Reported context adaptation is not a proof of causal learning; playbook growth can overfit, retain false rules, or hide provenance and ownership.
entries.falsifier: A provenance-bound condition/relation store fails to beat a matched evolving-playbook baseline on drifted held-out tasks, or its curation removes evidence needed to reproduce an outcome.
entries.verification_note: Primary arXiv record searched and abstract inspected 2026-09-07.

entries.title: ReasoningBank: Scaling Agent Self-Evolving with Reasoning Memory
entries.authors: Siru Ouyang, Jun Yan, I-Hung Hsu, et al.
entries.inspected_scope: arXiv metadata, abstract, and submission-history version
entries.mechanism: Distills generalizable reasoning strategies from self-judged successful and failed experiences, retrieves them at test time, and adds new learnings. It also proposes memory-aware test-time scaling using diverse interaction experience.
entries.hswm_bridge: SECONDARY_AI candidate: separate success/failure evidence and induce typed conditional relation candidates from contrastive episodes, then require external outcome and revision controls before activation.
entries.limitation: Self-judged labels and retrieved strategies can reinforce mistaken evaluations; the paper's memory is not a causal, provenance-bound canonical graph.
entries.falsifier: Contrastive relation induction adds no held-out benefit beyond raw trajectory or successful-routine retrieval, or fails under independent outcome adjudication.
entries.verification_note: Primary arXiv record searched and abstract inspected 2026-09-07; publication date is after this map's as-of date, so it is catalogued as a source record, not current-run evidence.

entries.title: Learning to Learn-at-Test-Time: Language Agents with Learnable Adaptation Policies
entries.authors: Zhanzhi Lou, Hui Chen, Yibo Li, et al.
entries.inspected_scope: arXiv metadata, abstract, and submission-history version
entries.mechanism: Meta-TTL frames discovery of a test-time agent-adaptation policy as bi-level optimization: an inner loop adapts from sequential episodes and an outer evolutionary search refines policies across tasks. The authors report results on Jericho and WebArena-Lite.
entries.hswm_bridge: SECONDARY_AI candidate: use it to compare learned update-policy families, but preserve a separate, schema-bounded admission path for each relation revision and test transfer without downstream rescue of failed mechanisms.
entries.limitation: A meta-optimized adaptation policy can exploit benchmark regularities; it does not by itself make individual updates provenance-bound, externally credited, or canonical.
entries.falsifier: A learned HSWM update policy fails to outperform a fixed conditional-learner policy on predeclared distribution shifts with matched meta-training, rollout, and inference budgets.
entries.verification_note: 2026 item: primary arXiv record, abstract, first submission date, and inspected v3 submission-history state verified 2026-09-07.

entries.title: ReAct: Synergizing Reasoning and Acting in Language Models
entries.authors: Shunyu Yao, Jeffrey Zhao, Dian Yu, et al.
entries.publication_note: ICLR 2023; this record uses first arXiv submission year/date.
entries.inspected_scope: arXiv metadata, abstract, and submission-history version
entries.mechanism: Interleaves verbal reasoning traces and actions so reasoning updates plans while actions gather external information. The authors report results on QA, fact verification, ALFWorld, and WebShop under in-context prompting.
entries.hswm_bridge: SECONDARY_AI candidate: use interleaved thought/action as a typed sealed trajectory format, distinguishing private proposal text, observed tool outputs, action effects, and later outcome credit.
entries.limitation: An interpretable trace is neither an accurate causal explanation nor persistent learning, and the approach does not define canonical admission or relation ownership.
entries.falsifier: Typed trajectory decomposition does not improve action attribution or relation-learning outcomes over an equivalently tokenized untyped trace control.
entries.verification_note: Primary arXiv record searched and abstract inspected 2026-09-07.
